items.note: Adenohypophysis occupies the anterior/larger part of the gland within the sella turcica, just below the hypothalamus/infundibulum. Sella position relative to the AC-PC plane is standard neurosurgical knowledge; adult gland height ~6mm, AP ~8-10mm, width ~10-15mm.
Neurohypophysis is the small posterior part of the gland, directly below the infundibulum/median eminence. Size and relative position are from standard pituitary anatomy.

items.note: Floor of the third ventricle at the top of the infundibulum, just above the posterior pituitary. No specific MNI-coordinate paper found; location reasoned from hypothalamic floor/infundibular recess anatomy.

Pineal sits in the roof of the third ventricle between the thalami, posterior to the habenular commissure and anterior to the quadrigeminal cistern; commonly cited stereotactic location is close to (0,-29,9). Adult pineal gland ~5-8mm long. No single open-access paper quote located in the time available.

items.source: De Leener B, Fonov VS, Collins DL, Callot V, Stikov N, Cohen-Adad J. PAM50: Unbiased multimodal template of the brainstem and spinal cord aligned with the ICBM152 space. NeuroImage 2018;165:170-179. DOI 10.1016/j.neuroimage.2017.10.041 (PMID 29061527)
items.note: PAM50 is explicitly co-registered to ICBM152 (=MNI152) space, which is the published convention this uses; paper is subscription-access so no verbatim quote. z extent here is a reasoned approximation along the brainstem's inferior axis: cervicomedullary junction ~z=-55, conus medullaris terminus ~z=-480 (whole cord ~45cm). Per-segment-group z ranges are given on the C/T/L/S items below; this item is the full-column envelope.

Sympathetic preganglionic column confined to the lateral horn, T1-L2 (approx z -140 to -433 on the column axis above, per PAM50/Gray's Anatomy segment-vertebra correspondence). x=3mm lateral of midline for the lateral horn location.
Parasympathetic preganglionic nucleus confined to S2-S4 lateral horn, within the sacral cord's compressed z range near the conus medullaris (~z -464 to -476 on the column axis above).
Ventral horn motor column for SCM/trapezius, spanning roughly C1-C6 (z approx -55 to -119 on the column axis above), lateral part of the ventral horn.
Dorsal nucleus of Clarke, present C8-L3 at the base of the dorsal horn (z approx -140 to -442 on the column axis above).

Right globe centre approximated at (32,48,-18) (orbit, lateral/anterior to AC); retina lines the posterior ~3/4 of the 24mm-diameter globe so its centroid is shifted posterior relative to the globe centre. No dedicated orbit-MNI atlas paper consulted; reasoned from standard orbital anatomy.
